name: Voxel Entry/Exit UV Calculation for DDA Raymarching
definition: A technique to compute the normalized entry and exit UV coordinates of a ray within a voxel during DDA traversal, enabling smooth terrain rendering by determining if the ray passes through voxel content or exits.
summary: Voxel Entry/Exit UV Calculation for DDA Raymarching computes normalized UV coordinates during traversal to enable smooth terrain rendering, distinguishing itself by integrating geometric UV extraction directly into the DDA step.
